plans.close_all: For October 26–November 1, close every position and cancel entry orders if account equity reaches 9,600 USD, including realized and unrealized P&L, fees and funding; stop trading until the next weekly review. Also flatten and cancel orders by 2026-11-01T23:45:00Z. Individual stops take priority; losses can exceed thresholds through gaps or slippage.
plans.hostage_policy: Allocate four 2,500 USD collateral slots. Each new layer has fixed 2,500 USD entry notional, giving 1x leverage, and a fixed 4% initial stop: 100 USD planned price risk before costs. Maximum three simultaneous layers, with the fourth slot held in reserve; maximum two correlated crypto shorts. Freeze new entries if combined remaining stop risk plus estimated costs exceeds 330 USD. Never average down, widen stops, increase size after losses, or open trades solely to rescue a loser. Hold a losing layer only while its setup and original stop remain valid. Bank profits net of fees and funding as buffer. A profitable layer may be closed alongside a losing layer when their combined net result is positive, but this never overrides a stop. No buffer-funded leverage increases this week. After two stopped-out trades, pause new entries for 24 hours.
plans.rationale: Prioritize capital preservation, limited layers and patient confirmation. BTC and ETH trade below last week's VWAP with weak daily momentum; rebound failures offer preferable short entries to chasing recent lows. XMR retains relative strength above its supplied daily moving averages, but requires a confirmed pullback entry. The selected 1x leverage is below BTC's 40x, ETH's 25x and XMR's 5x limits. Use raw candle levels and VWAP values rather than inconsistent supplied distance percentages or stale swing labels. The required 4h confirmations are future conditions, not signals established by this daily/weekly dataset. Collateral allocation is not a loss budget, and profits do not guarantee recovery of losing positions.
